hexamap: Hexagonal Heatmaps for Age-Period-Cohort Data

Source: R/hexamap-package.R
hexamap-package.Rd

Visualize age-period-cohort (APC) data with hexamaps, a field of hexagonal tiles that places the age, period and cohort axes at equal 60 degree angles. Unlike the traditional Lexis diagram, a hexamap does not compress patterns between adjacent cohorts or stretch patterns within a cohort, and adjacent tiles along every axis share a full edge. Implements the method described in Jalal and Burke (2020) doi:10.1097/EDE.0000000000001236 .
